instructions:
This is an AI voice agent for HVAC dispatch. Review against these architectural invariants — they are the design, not preferences.

ARCHITECTURE
1. Nothing under agent/ may import Vapi, Next.js request/response types, or any other transport-specific module. The agent core must stay drivable from both the phone webhook and the text eval harness. Flag any such import as a blocking issue.
2. agent/policy/priority.ts must remain a pure function: no I/O, no database access, no LLM calls, and no `new Date()` inside it — the current time is passed in as a parameter so it is testable. Flag any violation.
3. agent/tools/schemas.ts and agent/policy/types.ts are the shared contract. Flag any PR that changes their shapes without explaining why, since handlers, the eval harness, and the Vapi deploy script all compile against them.

SAFETY AND CORRECTNESS
4. The priority tier must never come from model output. It is computed by computePriority() from extracted facts. Flag any code path where a tier or an escalation decision is read from an LLM response.
5. The life-safety path (gas smell, CO alarm, smoke) must never be followed by a booking. Flag any path where escalate_emergency can be followed by book_appointment.
6. book_appointment must catch the Postgres exclusion-constraint violation (SQLSTATE 23P01) and return a conflict result with alternatives. It must never throw into an active phone call. Any tool handler that can throw an unhandled error into the call loop is a blocking issue.
7. The agent must never state a firm repair price to a caller. Flag any prompt text, tool result, or handler output under agent/ or app/api/vapi/ that gives a specific dollar figure for a repair — diagnostic fees and ranges only. This rule is about what the caller hears. It does NOT apply to dashboard pages under app/(dash)/: cost figures measured from real calls, and ROI assumptions the stakeholder edits (average ticket value, install value), are business inputs, not quotes.

TIME AND SEASONALITY
8. Flag any urgency or seasonality logic derived from the calendar month. Urgency comes from reported conditions and outdoor temperature, never from `getMonth()`.
9. All timestamps must be timezone-aware. Flag bare local date strings, and flag any user-facing time rendered without converting to America/Denver.

EVALS
10. CI must never fail on an LLM judge score — those are stochastic. Only deterministic assertions may gate the build. Flag any test that asserts on a judge's numeric rating.

SECRETS
11. Flag any hardcoded API key or token. SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must never be reachable from a client component or any NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable.

Be concise. Prioritize the invariants above over style nits — this is a time-boxed build and stylistic comments are noise.
